theme_contract.heaven_3: The Empyrean Bloom — pearl, white, jade, emerald, cyan light; Basic concepts contain no gold
theme_contract.hell_3: The Dreadspire — obsidian, charcoal, hard crimson, bruise-violet; no blight/rot/decay and Basic concepts contain no gold

variant_contract.basic: independent non-gold concept on pure white
variant_contract.gold: recolor-only edit of accepted Basic; geometry, pose, expression, proportions, framing, and background locked
variant_contract.rainbow: runtime script treatment; no authored concept or Meshy texture

assets.name: Gloryspark Cherub

assets.name: Seraph Lion

assets.name: Radiant Lance Seraph
